title: henckelia stolonifera

It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Henckelia stolonifera include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
